name: BancFirst Corporation
reason: Conservatively run, family-controlled Oklahoma commercial bank with a low-cost deposit franchise that never lost money through 2020 (worst year -26%), compounding adjusted EPS 13.1%/yr over 10y with ~13.5% avg ROE, flat share count and negligible acquisition spend; main caveat is EPS at 1.0x 10y high on a rate tailwind and Oklahoma energy exposure.

name: Marzetti Company
reason: High-quality, net-cash-until-FY26 specialty food maker (10y ROIC 17%) but adjusted EPS grew only 4.4%/yr over 10y (1.9%/yr over 5y, 4/10 years >=7%) with EBIT margin 11.5% vs 16% peak, heavy foodservice dependence on a few chains and a $399m FY26 acquisition; good but no route to >=7% EPS growth.

name: QuidelOrtho Corporation
reason: COVID-testing windfall reversed (adjusted EPS 2.12 = 0.11x 2020 peak, EBIT margin 1.9%) and the levered Ortho merger left net debt/EBITDA at 5.4x with large GAAP losses and impairments (GAAP EPS -16.69 in 2025) and shares up 7%/yr; balance sheet and earnings path fail the Buffett tests.
